'''Nia Adea''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked in the [[Thirsty Bantha]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. She was a traveler and an adventurer who rarely stayed on a planet for more than a few days.<ref name="SW Cantina" />

==History==
[[File:NiaAdea.jpg|thumb|left|Nia in the Thirsty Bantha cantina]]
At one point in her travels Nia visited the Thirsty Bantha, a [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] owned and operated by her old [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] friend [[Robb]]. When she arrived she witnessed Robb being threatened and physically assaulted by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[loan shark]] [[Varak'Cha]], who gave Robb fifteen days to get back the credits he borrowed to keep the cantina in business. Nia offered to help him raise the money needed.<ref name="SW Cantina" />

The friends implemented a division of labor: Robb would prepare the drinks, while Adea waited the tables. Additionally, Adea entrusted Robb with her recipe for [[flavor syrup]], intended to make beverages taste better. Eventually, Adea's assistance turned things around financially for Thirsty Bantha and Robb was able to pay off his debts. With the cantina back on its feet, Adea left to pursue other interests.<ref name="SW Cantina" />
